html:
Hello, Class 10 students gearing up for the CBSE Board Exam in 2024! This blog is your go-to guide for all things related to the upcoming exam. If you're wondering what's in store, how to prepare, and why it matters, you're in the right place.
The CBSE Board Exam for Class 10 is a significant milestone in your academic journey. It's like a snapshot of what you've learned so far, and it plays a crucial role in shaping your academic path.
Staying updated with the latest information is key to success, especially when it comes to important exams. In this blog, we'll cover the exam syllabus, study materials, crucial dates, and more to ensure you're well-prepared for the CBSE Class 10 Board Exam in 2024.
Let's dive into the details so that you can approach the exam with confidence and clarity.

Exam Date:

The CBSE Class 10th board exams are scheduled to start on February 15, 2024, and will conclude on March 13, 2024. The board is dedicated to organizing the exams seamlessly and equitably, creating a favorable environment for all students to give their best performance.

CBSE Class 10 Syllabus

Subject-wise Syllabus:

CBSE Class 10 Mathematics 2024- Syllabus with Weightage

Study Material for CBSE Class 10 Maths

1.    R S Aggarwal- Secondary School Mathematics for Class 10
2.    Mathematics exemplar problems for class X, NCERT publication.

Important Questions:

1.    Use Euclid’s division lemma to show that the cube of any positive integer is either of form 9m, 9m + 1, or 9m + 8 for some integer m.
2.    Given that HCF(420, 630) = 21, find LCM(420, 630).

CBSE Class 10 Science 2024- Syllabus and Topic-wise Weightage
 

Study Materials for CBSE Class 10 Science:

1.    Science for 10th Class: Physics by Lakhmir Singh and Manjit Kaur
2.    Science-Text book for class X- NCERT Publication

Important Questions:

1. For the reaction: 2H2(g)+O2(g)→2H2O(g), if 10 moles of hydrogen gas react with 5 moles of oxygen gas, calculate the limiting reactant, the excess reactant, and the amount of excess reactant left after the reaction is complete. Also, determine the volume of water vapor produced at STP.
(Note: You may assume that the reaction goes to completion and that the volume of gases is negligible compared to the volume of water vapor formed.)
2. A student experimented to determine the concentration of hydrochloric acid (HCl) in a given solution. The student titrated 25 mL of the HCl solution with 0.1 M sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution. The reaction between HCl and NaOH is as follows:
HCl(aq)+NaOH(aq)→NaCL(aq)+H2O(L)
The titration required 30 mL of the NaOH solution for complete neutralization. Calculate the concentration of the hydrochloric acid solution.
(Note: Assume that the reaction goes to completion, and molarity is given by the formula: Molarity=moles of solute/volume of solution)

CBSE Class 10 Social Science 2024: Syllabus & Topic-wise Weightage

Study Materials for CBSE Class 10 Social Science

S Chand for Social Science – N.K Chowdhry

Important Questions:

1.    Analyze the role of print culture in shaping Indian society during the 19th century. Discuss how the introduction of print transformed communication, education, and social awareness in colonial India. Provide examples of significant print publications and their impact on the socio-cultural and political milieu of that period.
2.    Examine the challenges faced by the democratic system in India. Discuss the role of various institutions, such as the Election Commission, in ensuring the effective functioning of democracy. Highlight specific instances from Indian political history that showcase both the strengths and weaknesses of the democratic process. Additionally, it suggests reforms that could enhance the democratic framework in the country.

CBSE 10th 2024 Syllabus: English Language and Literature

Study Materials for CBSE Class 10 for English

CBSE All-in-One English Language & Literature Class 10 by Arihant Experts

Important Question:

Compose a persuasive essay discussing the impact of technology on modern communication. Explore both positive and negative aspects, considering issues such as instant messaging, social media, and the prevalence of smartphones. Provide examples from real-life situations or current events to support your arguments. Additionally, discusses how individuals can navigate the challenges posed by technology to maintain effective communication skills in today's digital age.

CBSE 10th 2024 Syllabus- Hindi Course-A

Study Materials for CBSE Class 10 for Hindi Course

1.    Kritika
2.    Sparsh

Important Question:

प्रेमचंदकीकहानी 'ईदगाह' मेंबच्चेहसनकीसजगताऔरसमझदारीकोकैसेदिखाईगईहै? इसेउनकीव्यक्तिगतिताऔरसमाजशास्त्रकेसंदर्भमेंविश्लेषितकरें।

Translation in English: In Premchand's story 'Eidgah,' how is the alertness and intelligence of the child Hasan portrayed? Analyze it in the context of his individuality and sociology.

Tips on How to Prepare for the CBSE Class 10th Board Exam:

1.    Understand the Syllabus: Begin by knowing what's in your syllabus. This way, you won't miss any important topics.
2.    Create a Study Schedule: Plan your study time. Make a schedule that covers all subjects. This helps in organized preparation.
3.    Regular Revision: Don't wait until the last minute to revise. Regularly go over what you've studied to reinforce your understanding.
4.    Practice with Previous Years' Papers: Familiarize yourself with the exam pattern by solving past papers. It helps you manage time during the actual exam.
5.    Focus on Conceptual Understanding: Don't just memorize, understand the concepts. This makes it easier to answer different types of questions.
6.    Use Visual Aids: Visual aids like charts and diagrams can make studying interesting and help in better retention.
7.    Take Breaks: Breaks are important for concentration. Plan short breaks during study sessions.
8.    Healthy Lifestyle: Eat well and sleep well. A healthy lifestyle contributes to better concentration and memory.
9.    Seek Help When Needed: If a topic is challenging, don’t hesitate to seek help from teachers, friends, or online resources.
10.    Stay Positive: Stay positive and believe in yourself. A positive mindset can make a big difference in exam preparation.
Getting ready for the CBSE Class 10 Board Exam 2024 is a big deal. With good study stuff, a clear syllabus, and important questions, students can do well. The exam dates show the way for preparation. Good luck to all Class 10 students for a successful journey in the upcoming CBSE Board Exam 2024!

FAQ’s

1.    What is the syllabus for the CBSE Class 10 Board Exam 2024?

•    The syllabus includes subjects like Mathematics, Science, Social Science, English, and Hindi. It covers a range of topics designed to assess students' understanding of each subject.

2.    Where can I find study material for CBSE Class 10 Board Exam preparation?

•    Study material is available in textbooks prescribed by CBSE. Additionally, students can refer to online resources, reference books, and sample papers for comprehensive preparation.

3.    How can I access important questions for CBSE Class 10 Board Exam preparation?

•    Important questions can be found in textbooks, practice papers, and online platforms. Teachers, tutors, and educational websites often provide curated lists of questions that are likely to appear in the exams.

4.    What are the exam dates for CBSE Class 10 Board Exam 2024?

•    The CBSE Class 10 Board Exam for the academic year 2023-2024 is scheduled to commence on February 15, 2024, and conclude on March 13, 2024.

5.    Are there any specific tips for effective preparation for the CBSE Class 10 Board Exam?

•    Yes, effective preparation involves creating a study schedule, understanding the syllabus thoroughly, practicing with sample papers, seeking help when needed, and maintaining a healthy balance between study and relaxation.
